claim: Each positive row is a verdict about a model whose step counter has no declared range, so the verdict names no bound and no depth. It is not a verdict about a bounded model and must not be quoted as one. The two unbounded routes answer different questions: on the SMT k-induction route a model it cannot settle is UNKNOWN, and the CEGAR route is the one that settles such a family - in both directions.
controls: A weakened invariant must not be reported safe, and the finite-domain route must fail closed on an unbounded model. Both controls are retained in the bundle, and the weakened control is carried on both unbounded routes: k-induction withholds agreement on it, CEGAR refutes it, so the reader can see the difference between the routes.
